profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer | Java, C#, .NET | Springboot | AWS Cloud & Microservices Innovator | Scaling Systems with Lambda, SQS & DynamoDB
profile.summary:
I am Nisha – a Senior Staff Software Engineer passionate about building scalable, resilient backend systems. With 10+ years of experience in fintech, banking, and cybersecurity, I specialize in microservices architecture, cloud solutions, and modernizing legacy systems to drive efficiency and performance.

Expert in Java, Spring Boot, AWS, and distributed systems, I thrive in solving complex technical challenges, optimizing cloud architectures, and mentoring teams.

🔹 Key Skills & Tech Stack:
✅ Backend: Java, J2EE, .NET, C#, Spring Boot, REST, SOAP
✅ Cloud & Microservices: AWS, Azure, PCF, Event-Driven Systems
✅ DevOps & CI/CD: Jenkins, Git, SonarQube, Harness, AWS CodeBuild
✅ Observability: Amazon CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, Dynatrace
✅ Messaging: Kafka, SNS, SQS
✅ Databases: Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB
✅ Security: OAuth, JWT, API Gateway
✅ AI & Automation: Prompt Engineering, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot

Areas I Can Help With:
✅ Senior & Staff Software Engineer Career Growth
✅ Scalable Backend & Cloud Architecture
✅ Microservices & Legacy Modernization
✅ Mastering AWS Cloud, Event-Driven Systems, and Observability

Current Focus:
🚀 #LearningAI & AI in Backend Systems | 📈 #CloudComputing | 🔍 #MicroservicesInnovation

Always eager to innovate, optimize, and mentor—let’s connect and build the future! 🚀

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Creating variety of non-credit monitoring products to offer to customers.
• Actively engaged in creating serverless lambdas for monitoring using C# and .Net technologies
• Successfully implemented AWS Opensearch ingestion pipeline and high volume of data
• Actively working on migrating users from older system to newer APIs
• Developed APIs to integrate with legacy systems and external vendors along with supporting the testing and performance of the APIs for various microservices.
positions.insights: Skills: C# in .NET · Application Monitoring · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Problem Solving · AWS DynamoDB · Amazon SQS · Distributed Systems · AWS Lambda · Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) · System Performance · Coding Standards · MySQL · AWS CodeBuild

positions.title: Senior Java | Springboot | Microservices | Cloud Developer
positions.description:

• Improving/re-engineering legacy systems/monoliths to microservices.
• Integration with third-party APIs via SOAP/REST protocols.
• Actively engaged in all phases from requirement gathering, designing, implementing, testing, supporting, and deployment cycles.

positions.title: Software Development Consultant
positions.description:
• Build APIs for the fraud management system to identify, monitor, and prevent fraudulent activities when onboarding credit card applications from online banking customers.
• Extensively worked on connecting logic app workflows deployed on PCF to connect to an IBM MQ server on-premises for integration with external parties.
• Actively engaged in deploying to cloud data pipelines and production support.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Pivotal Cloud Foundry · Application Monitoring · Problem Solving · OAuth · Microservices · Distributed Systems · System Performance · Coding Standards

• Integrating with third party apis and external interfaces.
